role: fixed algorithm development using previously observed inputs; not independent confirmation

authorization.standing_user_reply: 允许必要的新实验，按固定方案依次推进
authorization.scope: Necessary independent-version component and matched development; old results/implementation untouched

selection_rule: All three roles in the first six Q1 blocks, already fixed by the earlier Q2 subset; no selection by fit outcome
training_rule: Same train-only RMS scales, exact V1 linear profile/rank convention, free signed equation amplitudes and summed log-RSS score; no truth or heldout in fitting, no V1 point warm start
factor_budget_rule: One full first-declared-fraction baseline. Remaining calls and CPU allocated by component dimension, largest-remainder call ties canonical. No quota recycling. One-component/null delegates to frozen V1. CPU caps checked between objective calls, overshoot retained.
solver_CPU_rule: min(600, 660 - measured loading/scaling CPU - 15); if setup below 45 seconds, unchanged 600-second solver allowance
worker_budget_scope: Recorded confirmation/development worker work plus a conservative interrupted-work reserve; coordinator, archive and editorial processing excluded. Not a total elapsed-time claim.

development_adoption_gate.shared_precision: 6/6 unchanged V1 controls reused; no new shared solver calls
development_adoption_gate.interpretation: Development only; passing permits consideration for fresh qualification, not scientific confirmation or broad accuracy advantage

stop_rule: Exactly 12 declared new partial/independent fits plus six unchanged shared controls reused. No V1 or shared-control rerun, budget extension, case removal, threshold change, truth-selected point, restart addition or automatic confirmation. If the gate fails, retain failure and do not expand this solver batch.
